messages.subject: Struggling to make multispecies occupancy models
parts:
Hi everyone,

For my masters thesis i want to make two multispecies-single season occupancy models. I have 37 cameratrap sites (rows), and 14 weekly sampling periods (columns). I have 5 sitecovariates (37 rows, 5 columns). And 2 observation covariates, here i am using detection/non-detection data of two predator species (37 rows, 14 columns). My detection histories for my main species are in a list, as are the detection histories for my predator species. Sampling periods align. However when i try to run the model: i keep getting this error: 
Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0L) :
'match' requires vector arguments
